name: 10_transfer_window
description: Admin enables windows after the first lockups end; a quarterly window clears 35 units at 125 USDC (bids above p* fill, the bid at p* takes the remainder, the ask above p* gets its units back), buyers pay the 1% window fee, sellers' accrued payouts are settled before their balance changes; lockup, eligibility, wallet-cap (invalid order) and direct-transfer rejections.

config.chainDomainNote: Bid/ask commitments, signed messages and the deployment domain depend on chain-specific wallet bytes and chain id; harnesses recompute them from the plaintext fields here (salts, prices, quantities, periods, nonces) and sign with the keys derived from `keys[*].seed`. Amounts, periods and ledger values are chain-independent.

steps.note: before the window: 400 units, holders have unclaimed payouts
the window must follow the just-reported quarter (Q2 2027)
direct transfers never pass, lockup or not
41 units > wallet cap floor(400 × 10%) = 40 → invalid at reveal, refunded
45 units and the bidders' stablecoin in the window escrow
S = 35 (asks at 120 and 125), D = 50 (bids at 128 and 125), d_above = 20 < 35 ≤ 50 → matched 35, R = 15
b6 buys 20, b5 buys 15 (floor(15 × 30 / 30)); b1 sells 20, b2 sells 15, b3 gets 10 back; b7 refunded; fees 1% of 2,500 and 1,875
units: b1 80, b2 85, b3 100, b4 100, b5 15, b6 20; fee collector up by 43.75; sellers' pending payouts preserved
b5 and b6 receive 15/400 and 20/400 of this quarter only; b1 and b2 keep what accrued on 100 units before the window
